name: project-fish
description: Only the tools in tools/ use this. The game itself needs no install or build step.

scripts.build-pistol: mkdir -p assets && blender --background --python tools/blender/convert_pistol9.py -- build/pistol9-source build/pistol9-raw.glb --blend build/pistol9.blend && node tools/finish_pistol9.mjs build/pistol9-raw.glb assets/pistol.glb
scripts.build-pistol-own: npm run export-arm-base && mkdir -p build && blender --background --python tools/blender/build_pistol.py -- build/arm-base/pistol.json build/pistol-own-raw.glb --blend build/pistol-own.blend && gltf-transform meshopt build/pistol-own-raw.glb build/pistol-own.glb --level high
scripts.build-arms: npm run export-arm-base && mkdir -p assets && blender --background --python tools/blender/build_arms.py -- build/arm-base build/arms-raw.glb --blend build/arms.blend && gltf-transform meshopt build/arms-raw.glb assets/arms.glb --level high
scripts.build-pistol45: mkdir -p assets && blender --background --python tools/blender/convert_pistol45.py -- build/m1911-source build/pistol45-raw.glb --blend build/pistol45.blend && gltf-transform meshopt build/pistol45-raw.glb assets/pistol45.glb --level high
scripts.build-pistol45-own: npm run export-arm-base && mkdir -p build && blender --background --python tools/blender/build_pistol45.py -- build/arm-base/pistol45.json build/pistol45-own-raw.glb --blend build/pistol45-own.blend && gltf-transform meshopt build/pistol45-own-raw.glb build/pistol45-own.glb --level high
scripts.build-soldier: mkdir -p assets && python3 -I tools/soldier/remove_patch_text.py build/soldier-source/textures/Mark_Helmet1_baseColor.jpeg build/soldier-helmet.jpeg && node tools/soldier/build_soldier.mjs build/soldier-source assets/soldier.glb --helmet build/soldier-helmet.jpeg --size 1024
scripts.build-beretta: mkdir -p assets && blender --background --python tools/blender/convert_beretta.py -- build/beretta-source build/beretta-raw.glb && gltf-transform meshopt build/beretta-raw.glb assets/beretta.glb --level high
scripts.build-gear: mkdir -p build assets/gear && python3 -I tools/gear/rub_headset_text.py build/gear-src/tactical_headset_-_game_ready/textures/headset_baseColor.jpeg build/gear-headset.png && node tools/gear/build_gear.mjs build/gear-src assets/soldier.glb assets/gear --headset-texture build/gear-headset.png
scripts.build-models: npm run build-pistol && npm run build-pistol45 && npm run build-beretta && npm run build-arms && npm run build-soldier && npm run build-gear
